dataset.name: 97 traces · 40 development task groups
dataset.label_scope: same benchmark-qualified task retrieval proxy; not actor, campaign, organization, or identity
dataset.threshold_boundary: Each outer-fold cutoff was selected only from inner task-grouped out-of-fold predictions.
dataset.description_zh: 97 条轨迹、40 个任务组的嵌套留出开发结果。可逐条检查误合并、漏关联、分数、阈值、候选排名及经修正命令提取器计算的画像。此队列反复用于方法开发，不是独立确认；同题不是身份标签。
dataset.description_en: Nested task-held-out development results for 97 traces across 40 task groups. Inspect false merges, missed links, scores, fold-specific thresholds, ranks, and profiles from the corrected command extractor. This reused cohort is not independent confirmation; same task is not identity.
dataset.zero_miss_sensitivity_zh: 逐折入选方案在 40 个有正配对的任务组中观测到 0 个含漏关联的任务组。零错下普通任务簇 Bootstrap 区间退化；若把任务组视为独立簇，0/40 的单侧 95% 精确上限是 7.2%，这是“出现任一漏关联的任务组比例”的敏感性界限，不是任务宏 FSR 的置信区间。
dataset.zero_miss_sensitivity_en: The selected policy had a missed link in 0 of 40 positive task groups. With zero observed events, the ordinary cluster-bootstrap interval is degenerate; under an independent-task-cluster sensitivity assumption, 0/40 gives a one-sided exact 95% upper bound of 7.2% for the share of task groups with any miss. This is not a confidence interval for task-macro FSR.

zero_miss_sensitivity.interpretation: sensitivity bound for the proportion of independent positive task clusters with any missed link; not an interval for task-macro FSR
